excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]小行星正在发射受控脉冲辐射。是不是有什么人，还是说有什么东西，想要和我们交谈？
excerpt.en: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]小行星正在发射受控脉冲辐射。是不是有什么人，还是说有什么东西，想要和我们交谈？
texts.en: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]小行星正在发射受控脉冲辐射。是不是有什么人，还是说有什么东西，想要和我们交谈？
sections.en: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?

texts.zh: 对巨型小行星[From.GetName]的扫描得出了有趣的结果。这块岩石的核心里含有携带微弱电流的导电晶体网络。[Root.GetName]上的成员辨认出这片晶体网络与原始神经网络具有相似性，认为就算该天体并不具有完全智能，也能进行某种程度的思考。他们请求将核心取出，并带到最近的轨道站以进行更仔细的研究。
texts.en: A scan of the particularly massive asteroid [From.GetName] yields fascinating results. The rock's core is shot through with a network of conductive crystals carrying a weak electric charge. The crew on the [Root.GetName] recognize this matrix as a primitive neural lattice and believe the celestial body to be thinking in some capacity, if not fully sapient. They seek permission to excavate the core and transport it to the nearest orbital station for closer study.

label.en: Make do with what you can study from the surface.

label.zh: 它跟我们有些相似。我们跟它来谈谈吧。
label.en: It is not so unlike us. Let us talk.

tooltips.zh: 命令[Root.GetName]将表面探测器连接到[From.GetName]并解码其所谓的神经活动。
tooltips.en: Order [Root.GetName] to attach surface probes to [From.GetName] and decode its alleged neural activity

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗小行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the asteroid's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的科学船的舰名。
note.en: In the game, your science ship's name appears here.

texts.zh:
[From.From.GetName]的核心刚从小行星外壳内部被小心取出，就对太空的真空环境产生了不良反应。在这块石疙瘩缓慢但不可逆地开裂之前，[Root.GetName]的设备检测到了一个突如其来的能量峰值。

我们随后回收到了大量的导电性矿物，但曾赋予它们生命的神秘电荷却不复存在了。
texts.en:
The core of [From.From.GetName], once coaxed from beneath the crust of the asteroid, does not respond well to the vacuum of space. The [Root.GetName]'s instruments read a sudden energy spike moments before the rocky lump gently, but decisively, fractures.

Large chunks of the conductive mineral are salvaged, but whatever spectral charge animated them is now gone.

label.zh: 这些水晶本身还是有价值的。
label.en: The crystals are still valuable in their own right.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的科学船的舰名。
note.en: In the game, your science ship's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我是[rock_scientist.GetName]。这项任务很有挑战性，但我认为我们已经成功将这些内容解析为类似于……也许不是语言，而是概念，或者想法。我们可以将类似的东西反馈给小行星，或许可以进行交流。

我们将显示一些 <过滤后的输出>，我将尽我所能对原始数据进行“更完整的解释”。
texts.en:
[rock_scientist.GetName] here. It was a challenge, but I think we've managed to parse the readings into something like... not language perhaps, but concepts. Ideas. And we can feed something similar back to the asteroid, to maybe communicate.

We'll display some of the <filtered output>, and I'll do my best to give a more "complete interpretation" of the raw data.

label.zh: 转念一想，这似乎不明智。
label.en: On second thought, this seems ill-advised.

tooltips.zh: 放弃直接与[rock_brain.GetName]的交流，保持距离进行研究吧。
tooltips.en: Abort any attempts at contacting [rock_brain.GetName] directly, and study it from afar

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗小行星的意识名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this asteroid's mind appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现负责研究的科学家的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of the research scientist appears here.

texts.zh:
<新><想法>。<原因>。<原因><令人困惑>。


“多说一句，[rock_brain.GetName]没有传统意义上的感觉器官。它将我们的输入认为是它自己的想法。至少某种程度上是这样的。”
texts.en:
<new> <thoughts>. <reason>. <reason> <perplexing>.


"To provide some context, [rock_brain.GetName] has no sensory organs in the traditional sense. It is perceiving our input as its own thoughts. To an extent."

label.en: <Do you understand that we are not you?>

responses.zh:
<想法>-<不同><协调>-<相同><分歧>-<不同>. 


“我怀疑石脑认为我们只是短暂认知偏差，但它过去确实曾经有过这样的想法。我们是转瞬即逝的消遣。”
responses.en:
<thought>-<different> <reconciliation>-<same> <divergence>-<different>.


"It is unconvinced that we are anything but a cerebral blip, but it has entertained such cognitive ghosts in the past. We are a fleeting diversion."

label.zh: <你们在[rock_sun.GetName]的轨道上漂流多久了？>
label.en: <How long have you been drifting in orbit of [rock_sun.GetName]?>

responses.zh:
<不是>……<刚才><不是>。<不是>。


“[rock_brain.GetName]不认识，甚至未曾感知过[rock_sun.GetName]的存在。它除了对连续发生的想法的有有限掌握之外，它还缺乏时间的概念。”
responses.en:
<not>... <previous> <not>. <not>.


"[rock_brain.GetName] does not recognize nor even perceive the existence of the star [rock_sun.GetName]. It also lacks a concept of time, outside of a limited grasp of the successive occurrence of thought."

label.zh: “我们从中得到什么有用的东西了吗？”
label.en: "Are we getting anything useful out of this?"

responses.zh:
<……>


“哦，有的，这种交流正在以难以置信的速度发展我们的模糊解码器网络。我很惊讶它的效果就像原生编码一样好，但我也收到了一些警告的读数……”
responses.en:
<...>


"Oh yes, this exchange is evolving our fuzzy decoder nets at an incredible rate. I am amazed this is working as well as it is, but I am picking up some alarming readings..."

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗恒星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the star's name appears here.

texts.zh:
<查--。<查询>


“正如我担心的一样。我们的探测器正在让驱动[rock_brain.GetName]意识的能量流失。[rock_brain.GetName]本身也不是一个完美的闭环系统，所以这种事迟早会发生的——尽管这需要成千上万年，但至少不是现在…”
texts.en:
<quer--. <query>


"As I feared. Our probes are bleeding [rock_brain.GetName] of the energy that drives its cognition. [rock_brain.GetName] is not a perfectly closed system so this would have happened eventually - though in tens of thousands of years, rather than now..."

label.zh: <我们有什么可以帮到你们的吗？>
label.en: <Is there anything we can do to help you?>

responses.zh:
<是>。


“它说它很好，但事实并非如此。我们曾尝试将一些能量反回神经网络，但这只会产生噪音更大的脑电波，而不是更强的脑电波。我们已经超过了阈值，无论我们做什么，剩下的一点能量很快就会消失。它没有办法检测到它的认知在减慢，也无法知晓这意味着它的终结。更不知道死亡意味着什么……”
responses.en:
<am>.


"It says it's fine, but it's not fine. We have tried feeding some energy back into the neural lattice but that only produces noisier brain waves, not stronger ones. We've already crossed the threshold, what little energy remains will soon peter out no matter what we do. It has no means of detecting its cognition slowing down, nor any reason to predict that this spells its end. Nor any idea about what it means to die..."

responses.zh:
<重复><以> - <感知>。<[rock_fallen_empire.GetRealName]>。


“它会再次想起我们，或者是现在，再次，通过它的思想具象化我们？恐怕信号正在迅速衰减。我们也不确定如何理解“[rock_fallen_empire.GetRealName]”——它似乎是我们从[rock_brain.GetName]得到的最接近传统语言的语言，但它的含义仍然模糊不清。也许只是我们的解析算法因为目标神经网络失效而崩溃。”
responses.en:
<perceive>-<within> <repeat>. <[rock_fallen_empire.GetRealName]>.


"It will think of us again, or it is now, again, embodying us through its thoughts? I'm afraid the signal is fading rapidly. We are also not sure what to make of "[rock_fallen_empire.GetRealName]" - it appears to be the closest to traditional language we've gotten from [rock_brain.GetName], but its meaning remains obscure. Maybe our interpretation algorithms are simply breaking down as the subject's neural lattice fails."

responses.zh:
<重复><以> - <感知>。


“它会再次想起我们，或者是现在，再次，通过它的思想具象化我们？恐怕信号正在迅速衰减——也许只是我们的解析算法因为目标神经网络失效而崩溃。”
responses.en:
<perceive>-<within> <repeat>.


"It will think of us again. Rather, it is now once again embodying us through its thoughts? I'm afraid the signal is fading rapidly - or maybe our interpretation algorithms are simply breaking down as the subject's neural lattice fails."

texts.zh: [rock_brain.GetName]沉寂了。科学专员[rock_scientist.GetName]尝试给这个小行星的矿物网络重新充能的所有方案均以失败告终；所有曾经激发其粗糙神经元的智慧火花都消失了，但我们从这个遥远的进化表亲那里学到了很多东西。
texts.en: [rock_brain.GetName] is silent. All attempts by Science Officer [rock_scientist.GetName] to recharge the mineral lattice within the asteroid have failed; whatever spark of sapience once animated its rough-hewn neurons is gone, but we have learned much from this distant evolutionary cousin.

label.zh: 这是这个“物种”的最后一个，还是第一个？
label.en: Was it the last of its kind, or the first?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你派出的舰队名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the fleet you send appears here.

note.en: In the game, the name of this asteroid's mind appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现负责研究的科学家的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of the research scientist appears here.

texts.zh: 不管在这个古代生物的意识世界里是什么情况，至少我们的现实宇宙还是好好地存在着。通过动用某些禁术和最新科技，我们的死灵法师相信他们能够为这个死去的生物再构造一个幻境世界。
texts.en: Despite what the ancient being may have thought, the universe continues to exist outside of its dead husk. Using a combination of forbidden techniques and new science, our necromancers believe they can put the lie to the departed creature's solipsism.

texts.zh:
我们的死灵法师已经在小行星脆弱的矿物层上留下了新的痕迹，在上面刻下了粗糙的咒文，并充满了脉冲电流。然而，曾为[rock_brain.GetName]的意识并没有回来。

现在它成了另一个东西，沉眠于一个邪恶的梦境中——被装上方向推进器，等待这我们控制。
texts.en:
Our necromancers have scored new traces across the asteroid's delicate mineral seams, crude invocations hewn in stone and suffused with a pulsing current. Yet, the consciousness that was [rock_brain.GetName] remains lost to us.

It is something different now, suspended in a sinister dream - fitted with directional thrusters and awaiting our command.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]部分中空。其内部是密集的蜂窝结构，由某种未知的合金打造。其中存放着许多储存外星基因物质的容器。这显然是一座生命档案馆，记录着一个失落的文明的基因资料。多数遗传因子都已严重损毁无法复原，但我们仍能从中学到许多。
texts.en: [From.GetName] is partially hollow. Within its interior spaces sprawls a dense honeycomb structure crafted of some unknown alloy, housing containers of alien genetic material. By all appearances this is an archive of life, the genetic record of some earlier civilization come and gone. Most of the DNA is hopelessly degraded, but there is still much to learn here.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]对小行星的调查暂时停止，因为一架探测器被突如其来的引力异常捕获。

在被极度巨大的力量摧毁之前，这架探测器成功传回了一些数据。而这股力量很快就消失不见了。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName]'s survey of the asteroid is temporarily halted as a probe is caught by an errant gravitational anomaly.

The probe manages to transmit some data before it is brutally crushed by the extreme forces - forces that completely dissipate soon after.

label.en: At least no one got hurt.

texts.zh:
一个拼凑的通讯中继器被很外行地绑在了[From.GetName]上。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这是海盗通信网络的一部分。初步分析表明通信内容并不包含什么敏感的战术信息，只是些海盗船船员间的寻常通话。
texts.en:
A cobbled-together comms repeater has been inexpertly strapped to [From.GetName].

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is confident that this is part of a relay network for pirate communications. Initial analysis indicates that the messages relayed are not of a particularly strategically sensitive nature, but rather private inter-ship communications between individual crewmembers.

label.zh: 也许我们可以一窥深空的生活。
label.en: Perhaps we can learn something about life in deep space.

label.zh: 也许我们可以一窥深空的生活。
label.en: Perhaps we can learn something useful about life in deep space.

summary.text:
# 小行星电波 / Asteroid Waves

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 小行星上的1级异常，生成权重3。若小行星带有战略资源，75和115的权重为0。  
  Level-1 anomaly on asteroids, spawn weight 3. If the asteroid has a strategic resource, outcomes 75 and 115 get factor 0.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 四个结局：75“岩脑”、115“蜂巢格”、130“引力压碎”（权重各1）和3065“非法通讯”（基础0；拥有birth_of_piracy旗标且领队没有统御专长时+1，机械物种则看生物专长）。  
  Four outcomes: 75 Rock Brain, 115 Cell Cells and 130 Gravity Crush (weight 1 each) and 3065 Illicit Communications (base 0; +1 with the birth_of_piracy flag and a leader lacking statecraft expertise, machines checked for biology expertise instead).
- 75选项a（5天后）→80“岩脑偏头痛”；c→76→对话77→78→79（岩脑死亡）→ 可选“复活岩脑”项目→81。b不继续。  
  75 option a (after 5 days) → 80; option c → 76 → dialogue 77 → 78 → 79 (the Rock Brain dies) → optional Reanimate the Rock Brain project → 81. Option b ends.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 四个结局互斥；对话77、78的选项决定能否走到79。  
  The four outcomes are exclusive; the choices in 77 and 78 decide whether 79 is reached.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 死灵技术分支（79→项目→81）使用与死灵相关的措辞（Owner.GetNecromancersUpper）。  
  The reanimation branch (79 → project → 81) uses necromancer wording (Owner.GetNecromancersUpper).
